notes.title: Update 1.3 - Oblivion
notes.notes: [p]As fans of the Elder Scrolls games, and to celebrate the latest success of the Oblivion remaster - we have released a map inspired by the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Featuring a hellish landscape and an open playing field, we hope you enjoy Update 1.3.[/p][p][/p][p]Changelog:[/p][list][*][p]New map: [b]Oblivion[/b] - an open, fiery landscape[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the resolution dropdown would not show all a user's display resolutions[/p][/*][*][p]Allow for aspect ratios other than 16:9 and 4:3[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements and updates to the game's codebase[/p][/*][*][p]General optimizations[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38952949/be8f304f712b482ed3f3ec988e5c4710a137ea6c.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: New Map: Egyptian Oasis
notes.notes:
In version 1.2 comes a new map: Egyptian Oasis.

Fly around and enjoy this gorgeous map based around the Pyramids of Giza.

notes.title: Update 1.1 Has Released
notes.notes:
Thank you all for the support. We are happy with the way release went and will continue to deliver content.

Here's what's new in [b]version 1.1[/b]:
[list]
[*]Event text that displays when you get cursed, or when you die.
[*]It's more obvious when checkmarks are checked now.
[*]Nametag bugfixes.
[*]"Status" UI has been made easier to read.
[*]Slur filter has been improved.
[*]Dropping into the water on "Midas Palace" no longer lags the game severely.
[*]Change default tag delay.
[*]Resolution dropdown is sized appropriately now.
[*]Fix resolution bug on startup.
[*]Minor bugfixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Catch Me If You Can has released
notes.notes:
Catch Me If You Can has fully released as Free to Play. Here's a list of changes:
[list]
[*] Now includes 3 unique powerups.
[*] Proximity voice chat.
[*] Cosmetics and inventory system.
[*] Map changes and additions.
[*] Playermodel rework.
[*] Plenty of bug fixes and small features.
[/list]

We hope you have fun!

notes.title: Catch Me If You Can is going Free to Play
notes.notes:
Hey everybody.

After a long and quiet Early Access, Catch Me If You can is finally going to fully launch. The game will be going Free to Play.

We will be launching alongside a major update, which will include some of the following:
[list]
[*] A new powerup system
[*] An inventory system with a bunch of cosmetics
[*] Reworks on many of the maps
[*] A new playermodel
[*] A complete rebrand
[*] Tons of bugfixes
[/list]
Thank you all for your support. We hope you will be with us on launch day.
